Identity.Name: Pset_StingPlacement
Identity.Definition: STING fixture placement constraints written by FixturePlacementEngine - the anchor a fixture was placed from, its signed offset and the host side (DSCH-38).

Property.name: PlacementAnchor
Property.Definition: Anchor reference used by FixturePlacementEngine (e.g. DOOR_HINGE, ROOM_CENTRE, WALL_MIDPOINT). STING parameter ASS_PLACE_ANCHOR_TXT. DSCH-38: moved here from Pset_ElectricApplianceTypeCommon.PlacementAnchor, a property buildingSMART does not define (the Pset_ prefix is reserved for sets the IFC specification declares).

Property.name: PlacementOffsetX
Property.Definition: Signed horizontal offset from placement anchor in millimetres. STING parameter ASS_PLACE_OFFSET_X_MM. DSCH-38: moved here from Pset_ElectricApplianceTypeCommon.PlacementOffsetX, a property buildingSMART does not define (the Pset_ prefix is reserved for sets the IFC specification declares).

Property.name: PlacementSide
Property.Definition: Wall or host side constraint (LEFT / RIGHT / EITHER). STING parameter ASS_PLACE_SIDE_TXT. DSCH-38: moved here from Pset_ElectricApplianceTypeCommon.PlacementSide, a property buildingSMART does not define (the Pset_ prefix is reserved for sets the IFC specification declares).
